text:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — launching micro-cohort 3 enrollment today. Gate will go live at 10am PT. Need enablement slots and one onboarding doc updated. @Matt any capacity?

Matt O'Neill: I can take 2 sessions the week of 5/6. Which playbook?

Sofia Li: Use `microcohort-playbook-v2` — updated checklist link: https://redwood/ops/docs/microcohort-v2 :white_check_mark:

Kiran Patel: Flagging renewal risk for Acme (pilot). They haven't signed the NDA yet. @CS-Bot, pull NDA status.

CS-Bot: NDAs outstanding: Acme Corp, Novus Labs. Sent reminder at 09:03.

Elena Rios: I'll follow up with Legal, pinging @Samir for contract wording.

Samir Ahmed: On it. Also request to change sample dataset path for onboarding. Here's snippet:
```
s3://onboarding/microcohort/3/sample.json
```

Aisha Khan: Thanks. For feedback capture, can we add a short pulse survey after session 2? 3 quick q's.

Sofia Li: +1. I'll draft questions today. Suggest Qs: ease-of-setup, inference-latency, docs clarity.

Matt O'Neill: Can we automate survey via post-session webhook to Gainsight? /integrations -> gainsight

Kiran Patel: Re: capacity — we might need a canary seat for high-touch. Suggest reserve a 'gatekeeper' slot for escalation.

Elena Rios: What's the acceptance criteria to move cohort from gate to full? Need clarity for SRE.

Aisha Khan: Criteria: completion of onboarding checklist, zero critical integration errors, signed NDA, 3 positive pulse responses. Can we capture these as tags in HubSpot?

Samir Ahmed: I'll add template. Also tracking `renewal_signal` metric — if negative pulse or quota issues, mark as 'renewal_risk'.

Matt O'Neill: Schedule: onboarding sessions Tue/Thu 11am PT. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood/micro3

Sofia Li: Draft survey: Q1: Was setup straightforward? Q2: Did latency meet expectations? Q3: Any blockers? I'll share in #docs when done.

Aisha Khan: Great — I'll send initial email to cohort at 10:05 PT. @CS-Bot add reminder 24h before session.

CS-Bot: Reminder scheduled for 2025-05-05 10:05 PT. :alarm_clock:
